text:
support_triage: :rotating_light: Heads-up: seeing a sharp spike in tool/function-calling failures from the hosted API starting ~10:03 UTC. Lots of 4xx/422 parsing errors. Customer-facing tickets coming in.
support_triage: Sample stack in Sentry shows schema validation failing on tool args. 4xx responses propagated back to customers.
support_triage: Dashboard: https://datadog.example/redwood/toolcalls?from=now-1h : error-rate +120%
support_triage: reproducible via the standard chat->tool flow, e.g. payload below returns 422: 
```
POST /v1/responses
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-4x",
  "input": "Call weather_tool for SF",
  "tool_calls": true
}
```
support_triage: Error returned: `tool_parse_error: missing required field 'location' in args` with malformed args payload logged.
jordan: Acknowledged, paged eng-runtime and oncall. I'm looking at recent deploys — any canary or schema changes in last 2 hours?
alex: I rolled out stricter tool schema validation on the canary cluster at 09:45 UTC as part of PR #4123 (reject unknown keys). Possible regression.
maria: Confirming: canary shows ~30% failed tool calls, prod ~10% but trending up. Canary logs have higher 422 counts.
eng-runtime: Investigating kernel: looks like validator v2.1 was enabled in canary and enforces required args strictly; older clients send extra nested meta fields which are now causing validator to reject.
emily: Customers are hitting hosted API; many clients still use the old assistant that emits args with `meta` wrapper. New validator doesn't tolerate that.
support_triage: We need a mitigation path. Options: rollback validator change, add temporary lenient parser, or add compatibility layer in the routing layer to strip `meta` wrappers.
jordan: Can we toggle validator to permissive mode remotely? Is that a feature flag?
eng-runtime: Validator has a runtime config flag but it's only exposed in the canary cluster right now. I can flip it in canary; need SRE help to flip prod safely.
sre-bot: Runbook note: to flip validator permissive mode, set env VALIDATOR_MODE=permissive on inference-runtime service and restart pods in a rolling fashion. Potentially ~2-5 min disruption per pod.
alex: Alternative quick fix: enable fallback route to model variant `redwood-chat-4x-compat` which uses older validator. That route exists but we only intended it for capacity failover. Could change routing rule per-customer.
maria: For priority customers with open tickets, let's move them to compat variant immediately. I'll prepare a list.
emily: Also seeing some 500s from the tool adapter when it receives invalid args — it's a downstream crash we should patch. Logs: ```ERROR tool-adapter - UnhandledKeyError: 'meta' in parse_args() at adapter.py:102```
jordan: Action list: 1) eng-runtime to enable permissive mode in prod (owner: eng-runtime) 2) SRE to assist toggling (owner: alex) 3) Support to move affected customers to compat route (owner: maria) 4) eng-runtime to revert or patch validator to accept legacy wrappers (owner: eng-runtime) 5) eng-ml to add schema migration tests (owner: emily)
eng-runtime: I'll start a hotfix branch to accept nested `meta` wrappers and ship a tiny patch to validator that preserves strictness for new clients but accepts legacy shape.
alex: I'll coordinate the prod flag flip once eng-runtime has the patch ready. ETA 30m for toggling with minimal disruption.
maria: Starting migration list for top 10 customers with active tickets. Posting IDs in #support-triage-ops.
support_triage: Noted. We should also update the status page and notify SRE oncall.
eng-runtime: Quick repro I used: 
```python
payload = {
  "tool": "weather_tool",
  "args": {"meta": {"location": "SF"}}
}
# validator v1 accepted, v2 rejects
```
eng-runtime: Patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/validator/pull/457 - adds compatibility branch.
emily: I'll add regression tests to catch this in preflight and release gating.
jordan: Support, please collect example requests from customers and attach request_ids so we can replay.
support_triage: Will collect and upload to the incident folder. Also escalating the higher-sev tickets to priority.
sre-bot: Deploy monitor set for rollback window. Alerting: pager if error-rate > 50% above baseline for 15m.
alex: Deployed permissive flag in prod on a small subset (10% nodes) for testing; error-rate dropped ~40% there.
maria: Moving two customers (cust-847, cust-991) to compat route now.
emily: After patch merges, we'll run canary verification with sample payloads including legacy `meta`.
jordan: Estimated next update in 20m. If engineers confirm patch works we'll roll to full prod in controlled window.
support_triage: Customer comms: posting interim status to affected customers: we have a regression causing tool parsing failures; workaround applied for priority customers; full fix in progress.
emily: Note for postmortem: need schema versioning header so we can evolve validators without breaking older clients.
eng-runtime: Patch merged to main, kicking off canary deploy.
alex: Canary looks clean after patch. No 422s on canary over 10min. Rolling to prod now with 5m pauses between batches.
support_triage: Thanks team. I'll update customer tickets and add the list of affected request IDs.
maria: All priority customers migrated; monitoring for residual errors.
jordan: Closing loop: follow-up retro scheduled tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Assigning postmortem to eng-runtime.
support_triage: Incident status -> mitigated. Will change to resolved after 24h stability. :white_check_mark:
